# digna Documentation

> Ontdek digna, het Europese AI-platform voor Data Quality en Observability. Ontworpen voor on-premises en private cloud, digna bewaakt de kwaliteit van data direct binnen uw databases — en zorgt voor compliance, prestaties en soevereiniteit.

## Platform

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/overview/): Ontdek de kernmodules van digna — het Europese AI-platform voor datakwaliteit en observeerbaarheid. Leer hoe elke module de kwaliteit, observeerbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van data in uw on-premises of private cloud-omgeving verbetert.

### Profilering

- [Inleiding](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/profiling/Introduction/): Profiling is the step that measures your data and produces the statistics digna Data Anomalies and digna Data Analytics are built on. It runs as part of those modules, entirely inside your database, and only aggregated numbers ever leave the source.
- [Hoe het werkt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/profiling/how_it_works/): The mechanics of digna profiling — the snapshot query and the
- [Statistieken](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/profiling/statistics/): The complete reference of statistics digna computes while profiling a data source — Row Count, Null Count, Sum, Average, string lengths, distribution counts — which attribute category enables each one, and how each is translated into SQL.
- [Datasets](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/profiling/datasets/): How digna Datasets split a data source into independently monitored subsets. Static datasets filter with a WHERE condition, Dynamic datasets group with GROUP BY, Hybrid datasets do both — plus relevance rules that suppress a status without suppressing measurement.

### digna Data Anomalies

- [Inleiding](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_anomalies/Introduction/): Leer hoe digna Data Anomalies automatisch volume-dalingen, ontbrekende waarden, distributieverschuivingen en onverwachte patronen detecteert zonder handmatig regels te coderen. Verbeter de datakwaliteit en observability van datapijplijnen met AI-gedreven anomaliedetectie.
- [Hoe het werkt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_anomalies/how_it_works/): How digna Data Anomalies works end to end — in-database profiling, robust prediction per series, a tolerance band derived from recent prediction error, and status rollup from check to data source.
- [Toepassingen](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_anomalies/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Data Anomalies in banking, healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and the public sector. See how AI-based anomaly detection catches missing loads, distribution drift, swapped columns, and unexpected KPI movements without rules or thresholds.

### digna Data Analytics

- [Inleiding](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_analytics/Introduction/): Leer hoe digna Data Analytics langetermijntrends, volatiliteit en datastabiliteit over KPI's onthult. Detecteer verschuivingen in de kwaliteit en observeerbaarheid van data, ontdek verborgen anomalieën en zet statistieken om in bruikbare inzichten.
- [Hoe het werkt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_analytics/how_it_works/): How digna Data Analytics works — a regression fitted over a configurable window of profiled statistics, producing absolute and relative change and volatility, evaluated against user-defined limits.
- [Toepassingen](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_analytics/use_cases/): Practical use cases for digna Data Analytics. See how trend and volatility analysis over column metrics reveals gradual data quality decay, unstable pipelines, and shifting business KPIs in banking, retail, healthcare, telecommunications, and the public sector.

### digna Data Validation

- [Inleiding](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_validation/Introduction/): Ontdek hoe digna Data Validation deterministische, regelsgebaseerde controles afdwingt met drempels, bereiken en referentielijsten. Zorg voor naleving, auditbaarheid en rapportage voor gereguleerde sectoren zoals financiën en gezondheidszorg.
- [Hoe het werkt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_validation/how_it_works/): How digna Data Validation works — the three rule kinds (rule expressions, uniqueness, referential integrity), how each becomes SQL, absolute and relative thresholds, rule templates, enumerations, and failed-record inspection.
- [Toepassingen](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_validation/use_cases/): Practical use cases for digna Data Validation. Record-level rules for invoice compliance, regulatory reporting, reference data integrity, and audit evidence in finance, healthcare, telecommunications, and the public sector.

### digna Timeliness

- [Inleiding](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_timeliness/Introduction/): Lees hoe digna Data Timeliness ervoor zorgt dat data arriveert wanneer verwacht. Detecteer te late of ontbrekende leveringen, monitor SLA's en bescherm bedrijfsprocessen tegen stille vertragingen. AI-gestuurde detectie voor verbeterde Data Quality en observability van datapijplijnen.
- [Hoe het werkt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_timeliness/how_it_works/): How digna Timeliness works — what counts as a delivery, AI-learned arrival prediction versus rule-based schedules, the alert margin, and how a delivery that never arrived is reported.
- [Toepassingen](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/data_timeliness/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Timeliness. Detect late and missing deliveries across large multi-source landscapes — with AI-learned arrival patterns and user-defined schedules for strict data contracts.

### digna Schema Tracker

- [Inleiding](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/schema_tracker/Introduction/): Leer hoe digna Data Schema Tracker kolomwijzigingen, datatype-updates en schema drift bewaakt. Detecteer en ontvang meldingen bij zowel opzettelijke als onopzettelijke schemawijzigingen om ETL-fouten, kapotte dashboards en verlies van data-observability te voorkomen.
- [Hoe het werkt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/schema_tracker/how_it_works/): How digna Schema Tracker works — a stored column baseline compared on every inspection, the three change events it reports, why a rename appears as a removal plus an addition, and how the baseline advances.
- [Toepassingen](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/platform/schema_tracker/use_cases/): Real-world use cases for digna Schema Tracker. Detect added columns, removed columns, and data type changes before they break pipelines, dashboards, and downstream reports — with a timestamped, attributed change history.

## Installatie en implementatie

### Besturingssystemen

### Linux

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/installation_deployment/Linux/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_linux_2026_06/): Stapsgewijze handleiding voor het installeren van digna Release 2026.06 op Linux — systeemvereisten, PostgreSQL-configuratie, nginx- of Apache-configuratie, backend- en dashboardconfiguratie, digna als systemd-service uitvoeren en upgraden naar een nieuwe release.

### macOS

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/installation_deployment/macOS/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_macos_2026_06/): Step-by-step guide to installing digna Release 2026.06 on macOS — system requirements, Homebrew and PostgreSQL setup, nginx or Apache configuration, backend and dashboard configuration, running digna as a background service, and upgrading to a new release.

### Windows

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/installation_deployment/Windows/Release%202026.06/installation_guide_digna_windows_2026_06/): Stapsgewijze handleiding voor het installeren van digna Release 2026.06 op Windows — systeemeisen, PostgreSQL-configuratie, webserverconfiguratie, backend- en dashboardconfiguratie, digna als Windows-service uitvoeren en upgraden naar een nieuwe release.

- [Hoe je een database met een dataproject verbindt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/getting_started/how_to_connect_database_to_data_project/): Stapsgewijze handleiding om een database te koppelen aan een bestaand project in digna. Leer hoe je verbindingen configureert, inloggegevens opgeeft en veilige toegang inschakelt.
- [Hoe je een gegevensbron aan een project toevoegt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/getting_started/how_to_add_a_datasource_to_project/): Stapsgewijze handleiding voor het verbinden van een database met een bestaand project in digna. Leer hoe u een verbinding kiest, instellingen configureert en veilige toegang inschakelt.

### Planning

- [Hoe je een dagelijkse taak inplant](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/getting_started/how_to_schedule_a_daily_job/): Leer hoe je een dagelijkse inspectie-job in digna plant via het dashboard.
- [Hoe je een crontab-definitie gebruikt](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/getting_started/how_to_use_crontab/): Leer hoe je een taak plant in digna met crontab-expressies voor geavanceerde timing.

## Integratie

### Databanken

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/overview/): How database connections work in digna. Every source technology is reached over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string built from ODBC properties. Covers driver installation on the digna host, the Add DB Connection screen, property encryption, connection testing, troubleshooting and links to the per-technology guides.
- [Azure Synapse](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/azure_synapse_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Azure Synapse Analytics over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Supports serverless and dedicated SQL pools, with the required ODBC properties and digna-side connection settings.
- [Databricks](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/databricks_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Databricks with Unity Catalog over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Databricks ODBC driver, personal access tokens, HTTP path and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Hive](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/hive_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Apache Hive over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Cloudera Hive ODBC driver, authentication mechanisms, transport modes and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Netezza](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/netezza_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Netezza over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the NetezzaSQL driver, the required ODBC properties and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Oracle](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/oracle_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Oracle over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Oracle ODBC driver, the DBQ connect descriptor, TNS aliases and the digna-side connection settings.
- [PostgreSQL](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/postgres_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to PostgreSQL over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the psqlODBC driver, the required ODBC properties, SSL modes and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Snowflake](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/snowflake_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Snowflake over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Snowflake ODBC driver, programmatic access tokens, warehouse and role selection and the digna-side connection settings.
- [MS SQL Server](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/sqlserver_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Microsoft SQL Server over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Microsoft ODBC driver, the required ODBC properties, encryption settings and the digna-side connection settings.
- [Teradata](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/databases/teradata_connector_guide/): Configure digna to connect to Teradata over ODBC with a DSN-less connection string. Covers the Teradata ODBC driver, the DBCNAME property, logon mechanisms and the digna-side connection settings.

### Single Sign-On

- [Overview](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/overview/): How Single Sign-On works in digna using OpenID Connect (OIDC). Covers dashboard and backend configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and links to per-provider setup guides for Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, OneLogin, PingOne and AD FS.
- [AD FS](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/adfs_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Active Directory Federation Services using OpenID Connect — application group, server application, shared secret, permitted scopes and the matching digna configuration.
- [Auth0](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/auth0_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Auth0 using OpenID Connect — regular web application setup, allowed callback URLs, client credentials, tenant domain and the matching digna configuration.
- [Google Workspace](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/google_workspace_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Google Workspace using OpenID Connect — OAuth consent screen, OAuth client ID, authorized redirect URIs and the matching digna configuration.
- [Keycloak](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/keycloak_sso_guide/): Configureer Single Sign-On voor digna met Keycloak via OpenID Connect — realm- en clientconfiguratie, client-authenticatie, geldige redirect-URI's, client secret en de bijbehorende digna-configuratie.
- [Microsoft Entra ID](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/microsoft_entra_id_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) using OpenID Connect — app registration, redirect URI, client secret, tenant ID and the matching digna configuration.
- [Okta](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/okta_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with Okta using OpenID Connect — app integration, sign-in redirect URIs, client credentials, authorization server choice and the matching digna configuration.
- [OneLogin](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/onelogin_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with OneLogin using OpenID Connect — OIDC app creation, redirect URIs, client credentials, token endpoint authentication and the matching digna configuration.
- [PingOne](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/sso/pingone_sso_guide/): Configure Single Sign-On for digna with PingOne using OpenID Connect — OIDC web app setup, redirect URIs, client credentials, environment ID, regional domains and the matching digna configuration.

## Changelog

- [Release 2026.06](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/changelog/Release_202606/): Lees wat er nieuw is in digna Release 2026.06. Deze versie introduceert de nieuwe digna Python SDK, Docker-implementatieondersteuning, een vernieuwde dashboardervaring en uitgebreide import/exportmogelijkheden voor validatieregels.
- [Release 2026.04](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/changelog/Release_202604/): Ontdek wat nieuw is in digna Release 2026.04. Deze versie introduceert geavanceerde tijdreeksanalyse met Analytics Chart, herbruikbare validatieregel-sjablonen, enumeraties voor toegestane waarden en relevantievoorwaarden op kolomniveau.
- [Release 2026.01](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/changelog/Release_202601/): Lees wat nieuw is in digna Release 2026.01. Deze versie introduceert globale databaseverbindingen, logische datasources, anomalie-relevantievoorwaarden, CSV-exports en geavanceerde gegevensvalidatie inclusief referentiële integriteitcontroles.
- [Release 2025.09](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/changelog/Release_202509/): Lees wat nieuw is in digna Release 2025.09. Deze versie introduceert een modulaire architectuur, vijf nieuwe modules, MFA via OIDC en per-module meldingen.
- [Release 2025.04](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/changelog/Release_202504/): Leer wat nieuw is in digna Release 2025.04. Deze versie introduceert de Inspection Hub, meertalige ondersteuning (Engels, Duits, Pools), import/export van data sources via dignacli, de eerste release van Module Analytics en een verbeterde dashboard-ervaring.
- [Release 2024.12](https://docs.digna.ai/nl/changelog/Release_202412/): Ontdek wat nieuw is in digna Release 2024.12. Deze versie introduceert een ingebouwde scheduler, PDF-rapportage, flexibele aangepaste kolommen, dynamische snapshot-query-plaatsaanduiders en slimme drempeloptimalisatie om anomaliedetectie en monitoring van datakwaliteit te verbeteren.

## Notes

- Every page is also available as raw Markdown: append `.md` to its URL, e.g. `https://docs.digna.ai/platform/overview.md`.
- `llms-full.txt` beside this file carries the full text of every page in one request.
- This documentation is published in 27 languages under a locale prefix (`/de/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`, `/it/`, `/pl/`, `/pt/`, `/sv/`, `/nb/`, `/da/`, `/fi/`, `/et/`, `/lt/`, `/lv/`, `/nl/`, `/cs/`, `/hu/`, `/tr/`, `/ro/`, `/sl/`, `/el/`, `/uk/`, `/ru/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`, `/hi/`, `/ar/`). Each locale has its own `llms.txt`. The sitemap at https://docs.digna.ai/sitemap.xml lists every URL.
- The marketing site at https://www.digna.ai covers use cases, industry applications and company information not duplicated here.
